Their DNA consists of 5 different types of nucleotides (and so is their RNA) and amino acids are generated using codons of length 4. Also, due to some chemical structure of the nucleotides, any nucleotide can occur exactly once in a codon. Calculate the maximum number of unique amino acids that be generated. questions.text: Which among the following statements is/are true?
